usage.desc: An inline calendar. To pick a date from a form, DateField wraps this one in a field.
`single` picks one date; `range` picks an interval with two taps.
Bound the selection instead of validating afterwards.
Localization: the component ships no translations of its own.
`0` Sunday, `1` Monday — a regional decision, not a stylistic one.

defaultMonth.description: Month shown on open when there is no `value`.

mode.description: 'single' picks one date; 'range' picks an interval with two taps.

onRangeChange.description: Called in mode="range", both when setting the start and when closing the range.
